thread:
anya (PM): Quick sync — two enterprise customers asked for incremental structured output + safe tool invocation. They want partial UI cards and a clear contract for when clients should call external tools.

sam (eng): Got it. We need to pick a wire format. Candidates: newline-delimited JSON (NDJSON), small JSON envelope per delta, or binary frames over WS. Tradeoffs: NDJSON is simple but fragile if payloads contain newlines; envelopes avoid that and allow metadata.

luca (eng-rt): Runtime note: envelopes buy us explicit fields for reassembly (seq, total?/more, content_type). Example envelope idea: `{\"t\":\"d\",\"dt\":\"struct\",\"s\":5,\"more\":true,\"ct\":\"application/json\",\"p\":\"{\\\"name\\\":\\\"al\\\"}\"}`. Clients can append p until more:false.

nora (devex): SDKs should hide reassembly. Provide events: `delta`, `structuredPartial`, `structuredComplete`, `functionInvocationReady`, `finish`. Also provide an option `autoInvokeFunctions:false` to avoid surprising behavior.

mika (sec): Security: must prevent accidental invocation of tools on unverified partial inputs. Add `reassembled_verified` flag that runtime sets when hash/signature of the reassembled blob matches server-side computed digest, or when `more:false` and `complete=true`.

sam (eng): Good point. Proposed finish_reason set: `stop`, `function_call`, `function_stream`, `interrupted`, `timeout`, `fallback`. Distinguish `function_stream` (args streamed, not yet complete) vs `function_call` (function completed and returned payload).

anya (PM): How should clients know they can safely call a tool? Two signals: `more:false` on the last chunk + finish_reason in [function_stream,function_call] AND `reassembled_verified:true`. If `autoInvokeFunctions:true` in request, Redwood will invoke automatically once verified.

luca (eng-rt): Backpressure and abort semantics: for SSE we rely on client connection close; for WS we can send a control frame `CANCEL` referencing seq id. We'll document both. Also include `invoke_deadline_ms` in envelope so clients can decide timing.

nora (devex): Dev plan: ship helpers in JS/Python/mobile that accept the stream and emit high-level events. Provide example: 1) start stream with `?structured=true&autoInvokeFunctions=false` 2) on `structuredComplete` call `client.invokeFunction(meta,args)` if desired.

sam (eng): Operators: add metrics `reassembly_fail_rate`, `unverified_invocations`, `incomplete_function_calls`. Canary fail gate: reassembly_fail_rate > 0.2% -> rollback. Also monitor `autoInvokeFunctions` usage and errors.

mika (sec): Also require opt-in for auto-invoke at org-level; default off. Audit logs for every function invocation triggered by stream with payload hash and user identity.

anya (PM): Prioritization matrix: MUST = envelope-based structured deltas, deterministic finish_reason set, SDK helpers, canary metrics. SHOULD = NDJSON shortcut for simple clients, WS multiplexing. WANT = server-side automatic function invocation for approved orgs.

sam (eng): Implementation estimate: envelope + SSE + SDKs = 5w eng-rt + 2w SDK + 1w docs. WS multiplexing add 3w. Security/audit add 1w. Parallelize SDK and docs.

luca (eng-rt): Interop example (minimal):
```json
{"t":"delta","dt":"struct","seq":1,"more":true,"ct":"application/json","p":"{\"step\":\"par\"}"}
{"t":"delta","dt":"struct","seq":2,"more":false,"ct":"application/json","p":"{\"step\":\"done\"}"}
```
Client concatenates `p` values then parses. We'll include a helper to handle escaping and binary attachments.

nora (devex): UX guidance: show partial cards but gray them until `structuredComplete` and `reassembled_verified`. Expose progress bar. For function calls, show a confirmation modal unless `autoInvokeFunctions:true` is set by the org.

mika (sec): For attachments: support `ct` like `application/octet-stream` and base64 chunking; include `encoding` field in envelope. Limit chunk size to avoid DoS; rate-limit per-stream.

anya (PM): Launch checklist (pilot):
- API: envelope schema v1 published + examples (MUST)
- SDKs: JS + Python helpers + mobile polyfills (MUST)
- Runtime: SSE endpoints support envelope; WS optional (SHOULD)
- Security: org opt-in for `autoInvokeFunctions`, audit logs (MUST)
- Telemetry gates: `reassembly_fail_rate` < 0.2% on canary, `unverified_invocations` == 0 for pilot (MUST)
- Customers: onboard 2 pilot customers (MUST)

sam (eng): +1. We'll draft the runtime contract with precise field names and sizes.
